<a id="作为不变量的交换次序--the-order-of-exchanges-as-the-invariant"></a>
# The order of exchanges as the invariant

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> With a footprint containing the exchanges, commuting unjoined exchanges keeps the partial order of joined ones up to renumbering and reaches every order-keeping renumbering. A world with the same exchanges, footprints and changes so ordered, from one start, agrees with a reordering at every step.

`order-of-exchanges-is-the-invariant` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A footprint says which relata each step's exchange touches (Footprinted) and contains the exchanges where every relatum untouched at a step takes no part in it and is unmoved across it (Footprinted.Contains, Web.Unmoved); every world has a containing footprint (Footprinted.contains_everything). Two exchanges are joined where they touch a common relatum or one touches a relatum depending, at the start or end of its step, on a condition the other touches (Footprinted.Joined); Precedes is the order the joins generate, a strict partial order (Footprinted.Precedes.lt, Footprinted.Precedes.irrefl, Footprinted.Precedes.asymm), growing with the footprint (Footprinted.Joined.mono, Footprinted.Precedes.mono, Footprinted.Contains.mono). Commuting two neighbouring exchanges not joined keeps containing and the order up to the renumbering (Footprinted.commute_contains, Footprinted.commute_precedes), and so does any sequence of such commutations, place saying where each step's exchange ends up and origin where it came from (Footprinted.reorder_precedes, Footprinted.Independent.keeps), each a step of Reorders (Footprinted.reorder_reorders). The converse, constructively by bubble sort: within a finite stretch, the renumberings reached by commuting exchanges not joined are exactly those keeping the order of joined exchanges (Footprinted.sorts_iff, with Reindexes and Footprinted.Keeps), and a second world with the same exchanges, footprints and changes on touched relata arranged in such an order, starting the stretch alike, agrees with one of these reorderings, the same exchange at every step and every relatum alike at every step (Footprinted.converse). No decidability of joining is needed, the renumbering being given. No premise.

Canonical source: [Reordering.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reordering.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The footprint is given; the order is relative to it.
- The converse is stated on a finite stretch of steps, with the renumbering and its inverse given (Reindexes).

P78b (work board, extending P78), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026: the partial order of exchanges as an object, and the converse. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): given a footprint, what the laws need is the partial order of joined exchanges, not a sequence of steps; this is Mazurkiewicz's trace theorem with footprints as the independence relation. See the integration document §102.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 266 theorems of Becoming.Order all have empty axiom reports, among them Footprinted.Joined, Footprinted.Precedes, Footprinted.Precedes.lt, Footprinted.Precedes.irrefl, Footprinted.Precedes.asymm, Footprinted.contains_everything, Footprinted.commute_contains, Footprinted.commute_precedes, Footprinted.reorder_precedes, Footprinted.Independent.keeps, Footprinted.reorder_reorders, Footprinted.sorts_iff, Footprinted.converse, Reindexes, Footprinted.Keeps, Web.Unmoved and Web.SameAt. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §102 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

The footprint in this record is supplied; P88 gives the least footprint with decided idleness and a lexicographic representative on a finite named stretch with decided apartness. No Foata simultaneous-layer normal form is built; only neighbouring steps are commuted, repeating which reaches any reordering of a stretch; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.

- Order.Crossing.reorders_joined and Order.Arising.reorders_joined: Reorders with sides only can commute joined exchanges, and the order is not kept. [Reordering.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reordering.lean)
